label: toolchain
caveat: Availability probe; absent native tools are BLOCKED, not PASS.
command_argv: for t in node npm corepack python3 git curl gh rustc cargo rustup pnpm nix pkg-config sdl2-config Xvfb xvfb-run; do printf "%s: " "$t"; command -v "$t" || echo MISSING; done; node --version; python3 --version; git --version; uname -sm; test ! -d node_modules && echo "node_modules: absent"; test ! -d .build && echo ".build: absent"
evidence_scope: host command only; not physical-TV evidence
